subject: duplex voice transport preserves the audio and words the owner actually heard
defects_closed: the browser transmitted microphone audio before ASR and TTS readiness, accumulating stale room speech while presenting a false listening state
capture and playback trusted requested AudioContext rates even when the device selected a different hardware clock
playback time accumulated across utterances because the binary utterance identity was ignored
idle playback emitted high-frequency progress receipts with no audio to report
barge-in flush discarded buffered samples before applying its advertised fade
live-mirrored voice turns were exported into chat again when the voice surface closed
interrupted replies retained unheard text in the visible chat even though spoken memory was truncated
stale playback and barge-in receipts could mutate a newer utterance
client buffer overflow could be reported as complete delivery

implementation.readiness: capture packets are discarded until the authenticated server emits voice.ready; floor and listen commands are reasserted only after that handshake
implementation.capture_clock: the AudioWorklet converts the actual source clock to bounded 20ms 16kHz wire frames
implementation.playback_clock: the AudioWorklet continuously resamples 24kHz wire PCM to the actual device clock
implementation.utterance_fencing: binary sequence and utterance headers bind playback, progress receipts, draining, and barge-in to one speech generation
implementation.delivery_truth: progress is monotonic, idle reports are suppressed, overflow stops the utterance, and only the measured audible prefix enters interruption receipts
implementation.conversation_unity: voice streams through the canonical chat bubble and exit export includes only turns that were not already mirrored
implementation.interruption_ui: the visible chat is rewritten to the heard prefix so UI, spoken memory, and delivery receipts agree

verification.worklet_clock_simulation: 48kHz capture produced one 320-sample 16kHz packet from 1024 source frames; 2400 24kHz playback frames measured 99.9583ms at a 48kHz device clock

claim_boundary.reason: the active resident-32B proof campaign owns the model lane; rebuilt-app microphone, ASR, Aura cognition, TTS, interruption, reconnect, and recovery evidence remains a later live gate

remaining_voice_work: make ASR and TTS warm state process-scoped instead of reloading per WebSocket session
prevent partial and final MLX Whisper models from evicting each other
arbitrate exclusive microphone ownership between legacy capture and browser duplex mode
prove language-aware endpointing and recovery under noise, pauses, reconnects, device-rate changes, and real barge-in
replace scripted conversational filler with Aura-authored semantic progress while retaining a minimal transport failure sentence
prove the rebuilt owner app end to end on physical microphone and speaker hardware
